title: No way to see that a post was edited
content:
If I reply to a post, and then the user edits the post I replied to, there’s no indication of this on the forum. This leads to confusion. For example, my reply on this post doesn’t make sense in context anymore because the user edited the post.

 

The old forum had this.

It really feels like the new forum is missing a ton of basic functionality features.

 

Oh we still can’t resize images in posts. Old forum had that ability as well. What did we gain by changing again?

scraped_replies.html: Edit: this reply has been edited.

See also:

 

If I reply to a post, and then the user edits the post I replied to, there’s no indication of this on the forum. This leads to confusion

Indeed.

This is one reason why I generally quote what I’m replying to.

 

The old forum had this.

Was that generally visible, or just for “Super Users” ?

 

It really feels like the new forum is missing a ton of basic functionality features

Yes, it does - even some that we spent a deal of time getting into the last one!

 

What did we gain by changing again?

I think the main gain was for ST in their relationship with the provider?

Users don’t seem to have gained anything

This is one reason why I generally quote what I’m replying to.

I guess that’s the way to go now. Usually I do this but if the post was a single sentence it seemed unnecessary.

Was that generally visible, or just for “Super Users” ?

The edit history was only available to Super Users, but the fact that it was edited was publicly shown, as well as the date it was edited.

Users don’t seem to have gained anything

Seems that way. Super unfortunate. And the pace of improvements is extremely slow.
